thread:
Olivia: Heads-up — Lawson Models onboarding doc is live for internal review. Need export-control sign-off, marketplace SKU mapping, and HW bundle pricing by EOD Thu. Planning coordinated announcement with EdgeForge (HW partner) + GCP marketplace. Two-week target for joint blog + listing. @Matt @Anya
Matt: On it. I can own marketplace SKU mapping. Do we have license variants (commercial vs non-commercial)?
Anya: Lawson sent AGPL + separate commercial license addendum. Legal needs to confirm redistribution terms. @Sally-legal
partners-bot: Document updated: https://redwood-internal/docs/lawson-onboarding (version 3)
Sally-legal: AGPL + commercial addendum looks ok at first pass but redistribution of quantized weights to marketplaces will likely need explicit permission in the addendum. I'll draft an amendment. ETA: tomorrow morning.
Lucas: For the HW bundle, EdgeForge wants a "secure quantized build" clause + KMS integration. We need to confirm whether Lawson allows redistributed quantized builds. @Courtney can you confirm infra constraints?
Courtney: We can support KMS integration. Quick question: who will custody the quantized artifacts — Redwood artifact registry (Redbox) or EdgeForge? That changes legal + distro wording.
Olivia: Lawson prefers vendor-hosted artifacts on Redwood Dedicated pools and EdgeForge receiving signed images for their devices. Sounds like redistribution — legal will need explicit permission.
Sally-legal: Agreed. Two paths: 1) Lawson grants redistribution rights for quantized artifacts in the commercial addendum with attribution + 30d embargo window; or 2) Lawson restricts redistribution and we provide EdgeForge signed access only (no redistribution). I'll propose both options for negotiation.
Matt: For SKU mapping, I propose three SKUs: hosted API (pay-as-you-go), dedicated-instance license (reserved nodes), and edge bundle (HW + offline runtime). I'll put pricing in the shared spreadsheet and tag owners: https://redwood-internal/sheets/lawson-skus
Anya: Also running a quick export control screen — Lawson HQ is UK but tech may still require EAR/UK export checks. I'll ping compliance if anything blocks.
Olivia: Can we get a short launch checklist? Paste incoming...
Olivia: ```
- [ ] Legal amendment drafted (Sally-legal)
- [ ] Export control screening completed (Anya)
- [ ] SKU mapping + pricing (Matt)
- [ ] HW bundle contract addendum (Lucas)
- [ ] KMS integration spec (Courtney)
- [ ] Announcement draft + embargo plan (Olivia)
- [ ] Marketplace listing drafts for GCP/AWS (Matt)
```
partners-bot: FYI — marketplace approval windows vary; plan for minimum 72h approval and additional review for HW bundles.
Courtney: I'll start the KMS + signing spec. EdgeForge asked for HSM attestation — is that a hard requirement or optional?
Olivia: EdgeForge expects HSM for signing images; include optional HSM in bundle spec and flag costs.
Sally-legal: I'll loop in export@legal and govcloud@sales. If Lawson resists redistribution wording, escalate to me and I'll handle the negotiation.
Lucas: EdgeForge PM also requested a short NDA paragraph for manufacturing partners — we'll need that added to partner playbook.
Olivia: Good call. I'll draft a one-pager NDA + access policy to send before artifact handover.
Matt: :thumbsup: I'll draft marketplace bullets (features, SLAs, pricing tiers) and share later today.
Anya: If redistribution is denied, fallback = inference endpoint + remote calls for EdgeForge devices (no weights handed over). That changes expected latency and SLA — flagging possible customer impact.
Olivia: Noted. Let's sync 30m tomorrow to finalize legal wording and split tasks. Thanks everyone.
partners-bot: Meeting created: https://calendar.redwood/evt/abc123 — 30m tomorrow.
